handstandVisibleWall.method: Actual unoccluded wall front/side vertical boundaries averaged at rows100:300, gradient-edge pixel centres; actual two unoccluded wall-floor seam minima. The left lower wall corner is occluded by the lowered head and is not measured. The outer image crop/floor-panel corners are not adopted.

barbellRowIndependentSoles.method: Actual neutral outer shoe silhouette above40 on black background, no mask morphology; white/grey calf and shoe connected component, actual shoe is widest portion in this low ROI. Not a calf/ankle brightness-core bound.

tbarUnchangedFloorMount.method: Actual floor-mount plate external silhouette maxRGB>30 within original source ROI60,1080,200,1120. Corners are observed material outline features, not ROI/canvas coordinates.
